output.reason: The linked PR explains what the one-line changelog note [ev-b9e3037ef8b7] leaves out. Prometheus changed its WAL watcher so that, unless writes notify it, the next read only happens on the next readTicker; this PR makes the Loki ruler's WAL call Notify() so the remote-storage watcher is woken on each append instead of polling [ev-b270867f3540][ev-b5e4a42ccdec]. The PR links the polling behaviour to issue 10859, where rule-evaluation integration tests failed more often [ev-b5e4a42ccdec]. The changed files are only ruler storage code (instance.go, wal.go) and the changelog, with no configuration or docs files [ev-bf6a346ce20f]. That supports typing this as an internal behaviour change to the ruler's WAL-to-remote-write path, with nothing for the operator to do; the exact exposure condition and whether any toggle exists are inferred rather than stated, because the PR text is cut off.
